messages:
olga_net: Flagging a weird one - APAC GPU warmpool started failing to bootstrap after a regional peering change. Lots of `kms:Decrypt` errors but they look like they were authenticated by the wrong KMS account. Warm pool dropped from 90% -> 65%.

ben_infra: wait, peering change? which route table was touched?

olga_net: we updated a cross-region transit route to prefer a new egress path (to cut cost) and it looks like some keystore traffic got hairpinned through the partner account VPC where the keystore proxy is NATed to a different AWS account. Requests show principal from our nodes but the upstream KMS calls are reaching another account's keystore-proxy which doesn't trust our provisioning role.

sam_sre: sample node-agent log: `2026-07-12T07:14:02Z node-agent error keystore.Decrypt AccessDenied principal=arn:aws:sts::999999:assumed-role/warmup-provisioner req=xyz` - note account id 999999 (wrong).

irina_security: that explains it. KMS keys are account-scoped; if requests route through a different account's proxy it will try to call its own KMS and our principals won't match.

ben_infra: immediate mitigation: revert the transit route preference so keystore traffic goes over the original egress path. Also add a routing ACL to keep `keystore.internal` pinned to local proxy subnets. Rolling the revert now.

ops-bot: network action: reverted transit preference in ap-south-1 (route-table rtb-0abcde) - propagation expected ~60s.

sam_sre: watching warm-pool. Also to blunt the immediate impact, can we temporarily add a cross-account trust for the partner proxy to accept the provisioning role until routing is validated? That would be a short-lived ACL rather than changing network again.

irina_security: cross-account trust is possible but we need audit and a ticket. I suggest we (A) revert network change, (B) open short-lived cross-account trust as safety net (2h), (C) add a routing test to PRs that change transit preferences. I'll file SC-920 and annotate the trust with expiration.

ben_infra: revert completed, warm-pool starting to recover 65% -> 88% within 4m. We'll keep the cross-account trust on standby but not applied unless we see leftover reprovision backlog.

olga_net: follow-ups: (1) add a routing policy that pins keystore.internal to local-proxy subnets (explicit route + security group lock), (2) include a canary that verifies both network path and KMS principal mapping before any transit/peering change, (3) cost note: the previous transit preference saved ~$120/day but the outage cost (manual triage and delayed capacity) likely exceeds that for a day. We'll include a short cost/benefit calc in the postmortem.

irina_security: also recommend adding an alert when keystore KMS decrypt rate drops but CloudTrail shows outbound to a foreign account - that should be anomalous. Filing SC-920 with owners.

sam_sre: creating incident INC-9002 and posting artifacts (pcap + node logs) to s3://infra-dumps/ap-south-1/3123456789/. Scheduling a 45m postmortem to cover routing safeguards and the small cross-account trust play.

ben_infra: thanks all. Reverting transit pref was quick win. We'll add gating on route-table changes going to the infra-change review board. :thumbsup:
